observations.observation: The garment is worn by a child model against a plain white wall with no product context (e.g., no hanger, tag, size indicator, or styling props) and no visible brand identity beyond the printed text on the shirt.
observations.impact: Reduces perceived commercial readiness for Tmall main image where product clarity and brand association are critical.

observations.observation: Only the upper torso and partial arms of the garment are fully visible; lower hem, side seams, back design, and sleeve cuffs are cut off or obscured by pose and framing.
observations.impact: Incomplete product presentation may mislead customers about fit, length, and full design, increasing return risk.

observations.observation: The printed text 'EST DIV. CHAMPS 77' is partially compressed and distorted due to fabric stretch from the model's raised arms and torso posture.
observations.impact: Slight reduction in logo/text legibility, potentially affecting brand recognition and promotional message delivery.
